meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会持续盯住一个 PR:约每 30–60 秒轮询检查状态,读新评论和未解决的评审线程,修复真实问题、跑测试并推送,然后重新检查。直到检查通过、评审决定可接受、没有待处理评论和未解决线程才停。
howto.when: 当你要 Claude「babysit」「监控」某个 PR,或持续检查它的评论、评审和 CI 直到问题解决时触发。

say.text: 帮我盯着 PR #123,直到评论和 CI 都清干净
say.note: 它会轮询检查并修复问题后推送

say.text: babysit 这个 PR,每 30 秒看一次检查状态
看看 PR #123 还有哪些未解决的评审线程
say.note: 会列出未解决线程及最新评论

howto.what_en: Claude stays on one PR: it polls every 30–60 seconds, reads new comments and unresolved review threads, fixes real issues, runs tests, pushes, then rechecks. It stops when checks pass and no actionable comments or unresolved threads remain.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to babysit or monitor a PR, or keep checking its comments, reviews, and CI until issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR #123 until comments and CI are clean.
say_en.note: It polls, fixes real issues, then rechecks.

say_en.text: Monitor PR #123, polling checks every 30 seconds.
say_en.note: You can set the polling interval.

say_en.text: Check PR #123 for unresolved review threads.
say_en.note: Lists unresolved threads with latest comments.
